qa_pairs.question: What is the specific subsystem covered in section 13 82?
qa_pairs.answer: Mixture and metering system, low-pressure reducer

qa_pairs.question: What unit is used for the torque measurement in this specification?
How many torque specifications are listed for the mixture and metering system, low-pressure reducer?
qa_pairs.answer: One specification (MAP sensor on holder at 3.5 Nm)
